spec_hint: Three ways to write it: an https address (for a directory on a site, its persona-extensions.json is read; or the index file itself); github:owner/repo[@branch] (read through the GitHub API; add a token for a private repository); git:<address>[#branch] (git@host:path.git, ssh://…, https://…; the git: prefix is optional for git@ addresses; uses the hub machine's own SSH credentials, no token). The address goes to the hub as is, and the hub says why if it can't be read.
sig_key_changed: Official signing key mismatch; verification required
rename_detail: Rename {from} to {to} and upgrade. Your installed settings, secrets and data stay in the same storage slot. This change requires your confirmation, even without new permissions.
